_comment: MSTR capital structure: claims that rank ahead of common stock.
IMPORTANT: every figure below is an UNVERIFIED PLACEHOLDER, shaped to be
structurally realistic so the script runs, and not sourced from a filing.
Copy this file to config/capital_structure.json, fill it from the most
recent 10-Q, and set 'verified': true before quoting any net-NAV number.
is the price per share at which the note converts. Shares are derived as
face_usd / conversion_price unless 'shares_if_converted' is given. A note
is treated as equity when MSTR trades at or above its conversion price and
as debt otherwise - never as both.
Preferred: 'liquidation_preference_usd' is the total claim ranking ahead of
common. 'annual_dividend_usd' is not subtracted from NAV (it is a flow, not
a claim on assets) but is reported as a recurring drain on the treasury.
